description: One page of coss.com's documentation as Markdown: a guide, an SDK page, or an API reference page (method and URL, parameters, request body, responses, errors and examples in each SDK). Takes a path from search_docs or a docs link, e.g. "/docs/email/sending" or "/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email"; "/docs" is the index of every section. Works without an API key.

offset.description: Character to start from, for a page longer than one answer (`next_offset`).

page.description: The page's path or URL, e.g. "/docs/webhooks".

name: read_docs
title: Read a coss.com docs page
